result.instructions: Tools for Talenta, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Who joined the company this month, and in which branch?"; "Which employees have not clocked in today?"; "Show pending time off requests for next week.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Talenta data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run talenta_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run talenta_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run talenta_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. talenta_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: talenta_list_employees
tools.title: List employees
tools.description: List the employees of the company (Talenta Data API v3) with name, employee id, email, branch, organization, job position, employment status, join/resign dates and more. Filter by user ids, email, branch, organization, job position, job level, employment status, or join/created/modified dates. `include` adds sub-objects (approval line, family, education, payroll info, custom fields); use it sparingly, it slows the call. Contains personal data. GET /v3/employees.

email.description: Only the employee with this email.

branch_ids.description: Only these branch ids (0 = head office).

page.description: Page number, 1-based (default 1). Use data.pagination.next_page from the previous reply.

tools.name: talenta_get_employee
tools.title: Get employee
tools.description: One employee by Talenta user id: personal data, employment, family, education, payroll info, custom fields and access role. Contains personal data. GET /v2/employee/{user_id}.

tools.name: talenta_get_employment_info
tools.title: Get employment info
tools.description: Employment details of one employee (branch, class, grade, job, contract and probation dates, approval line). Give exactly one of user_id, employee_id or email. GET /v3/employee/employment-info.

employee_id.description: The company's employee id (for example SDET-001).

tools.name: talenta_list_family_info
tools.title: List employee family members
tools.description: Family members of one employee (name, relationship, birth date, marital status, ID number). Contains personal data. Give exactly one of user_id or employee_id. GET /v3/employee/family-info.

page.description: Page number, 1-based (default 1). Use data.pagination.next_page from the previous reply.

page.description: Page number, 1-based (default 1). Use data.pagination.next_page from the previous reply.
